subject: QBR launch posture — roadmap status, timelines, and risk scan
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 07 Feb 2027 08:14:00 -0800
Subject: QBR launch posture — roadmap status, timelines, and risk scan

Team —

As we prepare slides for the QBR (week of Feb 22), I need a concise, prioritized view of the product/engineering launch posture across the next 6–10 weeks. We have three items we must represent clearly to Execs: Redwood Optimize GA, Dedicated EU pilot, and the v1.3 rollout for streaming kernels. For each area please fill the attached risk template (QBR_risk_scan_template.xlsx) and answer the three asks below by EOD Tuesday:

1) Current committed launch date and confidence (Low/Med/High)
2) Top 3 delivery risks with owner and mitigation(s)
3) Any cross-team blockers needing Exec attention (ask for escalation)

Quick status notes from my side:
- Redwood Optimize: feature-complete; integration tests flakey on long sequences (still investigating).
- Dedicated EU: infra is up in eu-west-1 but autoscaler tuning needs another cycle.
- Streaming kernels v1.3: upstream dependency on third-party runtime (llr-rt) has a patch pending review.

Please keep replies short and paste the table rows into the sheet rather than long email threads. I will collate into the QBR deck and call a 15-min dry run on Thursday.

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QBR-Prep-Launch-Deck
Attachments: QBR_risk_scan_template.xlsx, launch_posture_onepager.pdf

Thanks —
Olga
Olga Petrov
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.ai

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR launch posture — roadmap status, timelines, and risk scan

Olga —

Filling in the items for Engineering (summary pasted into the sheet and attached updated gantt):

1) Streaming kernels v1.3
- Committed date: 2027-03-18 — Confidence: Medium
- Top 3 risks:
  a) llr-rt regression affecting memory for long-context workloads — Owner: Marcus Lin — Mitigation: lock old runtime as hot-fix branch + run long-seq stress farm (2–3 days)
  b) Perf regressions on A100 80GB for batched inference post-kernel change — Owner: Infra Eng — Mitigation: roll back kernel fallback triggers; add perf gate to CI
  c) E2E infra test instability (intermittent flakes) — Owner: QA — Mitigation: increase test isolation and add targeted fuzz tests
- Cross-team blockers: need a short-term quota bump for our internal perf farm from Platform (INF-2147).

2) Dedicated EU pilot
- Committed date: 2027-04-01 — Confidence: Medium-High
- Top risks:
  a) Autoscaler misconfiguration causing cold-starts under burst — Owner: Marcus Lin/Infra — Mitigation: enable staged autoscale policy + canary traffic routing
  b) KMS key rotation policy mismatch with customer compliance — Owner: Security (cc'ed via ticket) — Mitigation: validate rotation window and add a retention policy option
  c) Marketplace listing dependency for partner onboarding — Owner: Partnerships — Mitigation: coordinate with Marketplace Ops (I can reach out)
- Cross-team blocker: need Marketplace Ops sign-off for listing readiness (ticket filed).

I attached an updated timeline (timeline_gantt_v2.xlsx) with critical path highlighted. I'm tagging JIRA INF-2147 for the quota ask.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Director, Engineering — Serving Runtime
marcus@redwood.ai

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 09 Feb 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR launch posture — roadmap status, timelines, and risk scan

Olga / Marcus —

Adding product perspective and a separate note on launch timelines (short):

- Redwood Optimize GA
  Committed date: 2027-03-25 — Confidence: Medium
  Risks:
   1) Eval regressions on customer prompts after quantized model rollout — Owner: Product Eval (Laura) — Mitigation: hold back 10% of traffic and expand canary prompts set; run regression alerts tied to eval suite
   2) Docs + SDK parity gaps for PLG onboarding — Owner: DevX — Mitigation: ship minimal quickstart + 2 example apps this sprint
   3) Billing/metric tagging mismatch with Hosted API — Owner: Billing — Mitigation: add token-level tags to dev env and reconcile with billing team (SERV-3321)

- Timeline shift: to free a small engineer cohort for the kernel hot-fix, I'm proposing delaying a noncritical Optimize UX polish from 3/8 -> 4/5. That shift keeps GA date intact and reduces risk to user-facing regressions.

Also sharing a note from our pilot contact at Orion Health:

> From: Julie Hopkins <julie.hopkins@orionhealth.com>
> Date: Mon, 08 Feb 2027 15:40:00 +0000
> Subject: Re: Dedicated EU pilot readiness
>
> Hi Laura —
>
> Our security team flagged a KMS rotation window question. If you can confirm the rotation schedule and provide the HSM audit playbook, we can sign off for the pilot.
>
> Thanks,
> Julie

Julie is waiting on the HSM/rotation note. Security has been looped on the JIRA; we should include the HSM playbook as a slide in the QBR appendix.

Attaching: timeline_gantt_v2.xlsx (updated with UX shift).

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
VP, Product Management
laura@redwood.ai

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
To: Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Feb 2027 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: QBR launch posture — roadmap status, timelines, and risk scan

Excellent, team. Short exec notes and next steps:

1) Executive summary (to be put on the first slide):
- Launch slate (Optimize GA, Dedicated EU pilot, kernels v1.3) is achievable with medium risk; top risks are runtime regression, autoscaler cold starts, and KMS compliance questions.

2) Ask: Olga, please consolidate the top-3 risks per launch into one slide (one bullet per risk) with owners and mitigation ETA. Marcus/Laura — pull the confidence levels into the timeline Gantt as color-coded flags.

3) Blockers needing Exec attention:
- Quota bump for perf farm (INF-2147) — I will escalate to Platform leadership if not resolved by noon Thursday.
- Marketplace listing sign-off — Stephanie, please own outreach to Marketplace Ops and loop Partnerships.
- HSM/KMS playbook for Orion Health — Product + Security: provide a 1-page appendix for QBR.

4) Pre-QBR dry run: Thu Feb 11, 08:30–08:45 PT — 15 min. Please have the slide-ready single-page risk summary before the sync.

Thanks —
Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Chief Operating Officer, Redwood Inference
